pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: join ANC visits and livelihoods by district and year, 2023 ANC and employment rates side by side
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: WITH anc_2023 AS (SELECT district, NULLIF(anc4_completed, 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) * 100 AS anc_completion_rate_2023 FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2023 AND source = 'synthetic Bihar ANC fixture'), livelihoods_2023 AS (SELECT district, NULLIF(employed_at_6_months, 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0), 0) * 100 AS employment_rate_2023 FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023 AND source = 'synthetic women livelihood outcomes fixture') SELECT COALESCE(anc_2023.district, livelihoods_2023.district) AS district, anc_2023.anc_completion_rate_2023, livelihoods_2023.employment_rate_2023 FROM anc_2023 FULL OUTER JOIN livelihoods_2023 ON anc_2023.district = livelihoods_2023.district ORDER BY district NULLS FIRST
